2020

Leap Scholar and IELTS Test Prep were launched, which revolutionized the study abroad landscape for Indian students.

2021

Leap went international! We raised Series B and C fundings, and are now backed by top investors.

2023

2024

We have a lot of exciting things planned for this year, but nothing is set in stone. Maybe you can help us write our story.

About the Role :

Leap Scholar is a one-stop platform for any aspirant wishing to study abroad. It is a transaction platform for students to apply to the university of choice.

The charter for this role will include :

  • Conduct online telephonic and/or virtual counselling sessions with students interested in studying abroad
  • Guide students on what courses to opt for based on their profile and interest
  • Assist students on deciding on the universities/colleges and programs to opt for
  • Assist in preparing and filing of their applications
  • Guiding students on the visa process and visa applications
  • Participate in educational activities such as exhibitions and events as and when required
  • Support and mentor counsellors in delivering high-quality student counselling and achieving set targets.

Ideal Persona would :

  • 1+ years of experience in counselling students on admissions to universities and colleges in the UK/Europe.
  • Understanding of various courses and career options across various disciplines
  • Experience of guiding students on the best course option based on the studentsâ€™ profile and career interests
  • Sound understanding of the admission process for Diploma, Bachelors, Post-Graduation diploma, and Masters degrees in the UK/Europe.

If you have the skills and experience required for this position and are passionate about international education, we encourage you to apply at karuna.arora@leapfinance.com.

About Leap

Leap has helped 300,000+ students achieve their study abroad dreams across 25+ countries. With 700+ university partnerships and backing from leading global investors, our mission is to make quality international education accessible to every ambitious student.

About the Role

We're expanding our IELTS training presence in Chennai through our network of partner colleges and are looking for a passionate IELTS Trainer. This is a field-based role where you will travel to assigned partner colleges across Chennai to conduct IELTS preparation classes, workshops, and study abroad seminars.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Visit assigned partner colleges across Chennai to conduct IELTS preparation classes.

  • Deliver IELTS and study abroad awareness seminars and workshops on college campuses.

  • Assess students' English proficiency and provide personalized feedback.

  • Conduct mock IELTS tests and track student progress.

  • Guide students on effective test-taking strategies and exam techniques.

  • Motivate and mentor students throughout their IELTS preparation journey.

  • Build strong relationships with partner college stakeholders to ensure smooth program delivery.

  • Counsel interested students and support enrollments into Leap's IELTS programs.

Ideal Persona

  • 1â€“3 years of experience in IELTS or English language training.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and classroom management skills.

  • Comfortable traveling across Chennai to conduct classes and seminars at partner colleges.

  • Passionate about teaching, mentoring students, and driving learning outcomes.

  • Self-motivated, organized, and adaptable to a field-based role

About the role:
As an Learning & Development Lead at Leap Scholar, you will be responsible for building
and delivering impactful learning programs for our Study Abroad Counsellors. The role will
focus on identifying capability gaps, developing relevant learning interventions, and using
research and data to improve counsellor performance, with a preference for candidates
having exposure to European study destinations.


The Charter for this role would include:
â— Design and deliver training programs for Study Abroad Counsellors across
counselling, destination, university and conversion skills.
â— Identify capability gaps and develop targeted learning interventions based on business
needs and performance data.
â— Create engaging PPTs, training modules, assessments and learning content using
relevant market research.
â— Conduct research on international education trends, universities, courses and study
destinations to keep training content relevant.
â— Leverage LMS and CRM platforms to manage learning programs, track effectiveness and
analyse counsellor performance.
â— Track training effectiveness and learning outcomes through assessments, feedback
and business performance metrics.
â— Prepare L&D reports, dashboards and presentations to share insights and
recommendations with stakeholders.
â— Partner with cross-functional teams to drive learning outcomes and continuously
improve counsellor capability.


Ideal Persona Would:
â— Have 6â€“7 years of experience in Learning & Development, Training or Capability
Development.
â— Have proven experience in training Study Abroad Counsellors; international education
experience is strongly preferred.
â— Preferably have exposure to European study destinations/markets.
â— Be strong in research, data analysis, PowerPoint and presentation creation.
â— Have hands-on experience with LMS and CRM platforms.
â— Possess strong communication, facilitation and stakeholder management skills.
â— Be able to translate business requirements and data into practical and impactful
learning interventions.


If you are passionate about building high-performing counselling teams and creating
impactful learning experiences in the study abroad ecosystem, we encourage you to apply!

About the Role

Weâ€™re looking for a User Researcher with 2â€“3 years of experience who can work across both product and strategy research.

Youâ€™ll work closely with Product, Strategy and Business teams to understand users, identify opportunities and bring user insights into important product and business decisions.

What Youâ€™ll Do

  • Own research projects end-to-end from defining the research problem and methodology to conducting research and sharing insights.

  • Conduct user interviews, usability studies, surveys and other qualitative/quantitative research as required.

  • Work with Product and Strategy teams to understand user behaviour, needs, pain points and market opportunities.

  • Translate research findings into clear, actionable recommendations for product and business teams.

  • Support product discovery, validation and strategic problem statements through research.

  • Build research frameworks and approaches for new and ambiguous problem statements.

  • Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

  • Lead and mentor a small team of researchers and ensure quality and rigour across research projects.

What Weâ€™re Looking For
